evidence.citation: Peng & Wang (2008), The Momentum and Mean Reversion of Nikkei Index Futures: A Markov Chain Analysis
evidence.direct_claim: Significant 1-minute return momentum and significant 10-minute return mean reversion in Nikkei index futures; switching robust to intraday seasonality.

stage_a.non_overlap_rationale: End before exact JNU Micro launch.

data.cloud_output: Per-day non-reconstructive sufficient statistics only; no raw minute bars or interval return series.

session_rules.continuity: Each historical day_session_segment is an independent sequence. Never cross lunch break/session boundary.
session_rules.bar_label_semantics: Source minute-start grid already verified against official OSE opens/closes.
session_rules.primary_return: log close-to-close 1-minute return; first bar in each continuous session segment has no return.

cells.construction: Adjacent 1-minute close-to-close returns within each continuous OSE day-session segment.
cells.primary_daily_effect: Mean over eligible pairs of sign(r_prev) * r_next; predecessor zero => abstain.
cells.accuracy: Among pairs with nonzero predecessor and nonzero target, fraction signal sign equals target sign.

cells.construction: Non-overlapping 10-minute returns formed by summing ten consecutive 1-minute returns, aligned to each continuous historical OSE day-session segment; adjacent 10m blocks only.
cells.primary_daily_effect: Mean over eligible block pairs of -sign(R10_prev) * R10_next; predecessor zero => abstain.
cells.accuracy: Among pairs with nonzero predecessor and nonzero target, fraction reversal signal sign equals target sign.

inference.daily_weighting: Equal-weight days; each day contributes its daily mean signal payoff.

bootstrap.method: iid resample trading days with replacement

stage_a_pass_rule: Minimum 1000 usable Mini trading days in each cell.
Both H1 and H2 mean daily signal payoffs > 0.
Both H1 and H2 aggregate nonzero-target directional accuracies > 0.5.
Both H1 and H2 bootstrap P(mean daily signal payoff > 0) >= 0.95.
H1/H2 one-sided bootstrap p-values pass Holm alpha=0.10.
stage_b_pass_rule: Stage A must PASS; otherwise Stage B statistical evaluation is prohibited.
Minimum 500 usable exact-JNU trading days in each cell.
Identical H1/H2 constructions, zero handling, bootstrap, and Holm correction; no retuning.
Both H1 and H2 mean daily signal payoffs > 0.
Both H1 and H2 aggregate nonzero-target directional accuracies > 0.5.
Both H1 and H2 bootstrap P(mean daily signal payoff > 0) >= 0.95.
H1/H2 one-sided bootstrap p-values pass Holm alpha=0.10.
diagnostics_non_promotional: Gross payoff distribution before transaction costs.

interpretation.pass: If both stages pass, promote only to a directional information candidate. A concrete executable rule must still pass downstream execution/cost/overfit/forward stages.
interpretation.fail: Close current family. Do not change horizons, use overlapping 10m windows, drop the failed cell, or add filters to rescue.

forbidden: Keep only 1m momentum or only 10m reversal after the other cell fails.
Switch to night-session data as a rescue.
Treat zero returns as automatic correct predictions.
Add RSI/MACD/volume filters/regimes to rescue G1.
Claim tradable alpha before transaction-cost/microstructure validation.
Use exact-JNU Stage B to rescue failed Mini Stage A.
